label: 7과 1번
en: People in Valencia celebrate the coming of spring with the Fallas festival.

label: 7과 2번
en: This festival takes place from March 15 to 19.

label: 7과 3번
en: During the festival, people enjoy parades and fireworks.

label: 7과 4번
en: The stars of the festival are fallas, giant wooden statues.

label: 7과 5번
en: You can find hundreds of them all over the city.

label: 7과 6번
en: Surprisingly, the fallas are burned on the last day of the festival.

label: 7과 7번
en: Burning them symbolizes saying goodbye to old things and hello to a new start.

label: 7과 8번
en: Winter in Sweden is long and dark, so the people there especially welcome summer.

label: 7과 9번
en: To celebrate the longest day of the year, they have a special festival.

label: 7과 10번
en: They call it the Midsummer festival.

label: 7과 11번
en: The festival starts on the Friday evening between June 19 and 25 and ends on the Sunday.

label: 7과 12번
en: During the festival, people decorate a tall pole with flowers and green leaves and enjoy traditional dances around it.

label: 7과 13번
en: Because the sun hardly sets at this time of year in Sweden, people can enjoy the festival all night long.

label: 7과 14번
en: Many Mexicans believe that once a year dead people come back home to meet their family and friends.

label: 7과 15번
en: They call this day the Day of the Dead.

label: 7과 16번
en: To welcome dead people, Mexicans hold a festival on November 1 and 2.

label: 7과 17번
en: They believe it is important to remember dead people.

label: 7과 18번
en: So, people set up altars in their homes and have big parties in cemeteries.

label: 7과 19번
en: In some areas, people dress up like skeletons and hold big parades.

label: 7과 20번
en: At the end of February, people in Alaska hold the Fur Rondy festival, one of the biggest winter festivals in the world.

label: 7과 21번
en: During this festival, visitors can enjoy various winter sports and Alaskan traditional games.

label: 7과 22번
en: They can also enjoy many special events such as the Running of the Reindeer.

label: 7과 23번
en: People who participate in this race wear fun costumes and try to run faster than reindeer.

label: 7과 24번
en: Is it possible to do so?

label: 7과 25번
en: Not really, but it doesn’t matter.

label: 7과 26번
en: Everyone is just having fun!

label: 8과 1번
en: Eckels walked into the office of Time Travel.

label: 8과 2번
en: The big sign on the wall said, “NAME ANY YEAR IN THE PAST. WE TAKE YOU THERE.”

label: 8과 3번
en: There was a TV on the wall, and Mr. Keith, the new president, was on the news.

label: 8과 4번
en: “How can we help you?” said Mr. Parker, the founder of Time Travel.

label: 8과 5번 ①
en: “I’ve always wanted to see a dinosaur.”

label: 8과 5번 ②
en: “Is it possible?” asked Eckels.

label: 8과 6번 ①
en: “Sure,” said Mr. Parker.

label: 8과 6번 ②
en: “We can take you back to the jungle of 60 million years ago.”

label: 8과 7번 ①
en: “Great,” said Eckels.

label: 8과 7번 ②
en: “Can you take me there now?”

label: 8과 8번 ①
en: “You’re lucky.”

label: 8과 8번 ②
en: “There’s a time machine that leaves in 10 minutes,” said Mr. Parker.

label: 8과 9번
en: “This is Travis, your travel guide,” he continued.

label: 8과 10번
en: “To stay safe, you must follow his instructions.”

label: 8과 11번
en: Inside the time machine, there were two other travelers.

label: 8과 12번
en: Eckels sat down and closed his eyes.

label: 8과 13번
en: He felt the machine moving under his feet.

label: 8과 14번
en: After only a few minutes, the machine stopped.

label: 8과 15번
en: “We’ve just arrived in the jungle of 60 million years ago,” Travis explained.

label: 8과 16번 ①
en: “Do you see the path over there?”

label: 8과 16번 ②
en: “You must not leave it at any time.”

label: 8과 17번 ①
en: “Do not touch anything.”

label: 8과 17번 ②
en: “You might kill something by accident.”

label: 8과 18번
en: “A little change here can cause something unthinkable in the future.”

label: 8과 19번 ①
en: Slowly, everyone got out of the time machine.

label: 8과 19번 ②
en: The jungle was covered in fog.

label: 8과 20번 ①
en: It was very quiet.

label: 8과 20번 ②
en: “I’m so excited,” said Eckels.

label: 8과 21번 ①
en: “Be careful.”

label: 8과 21번 ②
en: “Some of the dinosaurs are hungry,” said Travis.

label: 8과 22번 ①
en: “Just stay calm.”

label: 8과 22번 ②
en: “I don’t want you to do anything foolish.”

label: 8과 23번 ①
en: “Don’t worry.”

label: 8과 23번 ②
en: “I’m not a fool,” said Eckels.

label: 8과 24번
en: They all began to walk on the path.

label: 8과 25번 ①
en: After some time, Travis whispered, “Look over there.”

label: 8과 25번 ②
en: “There is a T. rex.”

label: 8과 26번
en: One hundred meters away, a T. rex slowly appeared.

label: 8과 27번
en: “It,” whispered Eckels.

label: 8과 28번 ①
en: “It . . . is huge.”

label: 8과 28번 ②
en: “I’ve never seen such a huge thing.”

label: 8과 28번 ③
en: “I’m so scared,” said Eckels.

label: 8과 29번 ①
en: “Sh . . . quiet!” Travis said angrily.

label: 8과 29번 ②
en: “You don’t want it to see you.”

label: 8과 30번 ①
en: “I can’t breathe,” said Eckels.

label: 8과 30번 ②
en: “Get me out of here!”

label: 8과 31번 ①
en: “Don’t panic, Eckels,” said Travis.

label: 8과 31번 ②
en: “Turn around, and walk quietly back to the machine.”

label: 8과 32번
en: Eckels turned around and started to run.

label: 8과 33번
en: He was so terrified that he left the path by accident.

label: 8과 34번 ①
en: “Eckels!” shouted Travis.

label: 8과 34번 ②
en: “Don’t leave the path!”

label: 8과 35번
en: The T. rex heard Travis and turned its head toward him and the other travelers.

label: 8과 36번
en: There was a moment of silence.

label: 8과 37번
en: Then, it suddenly started to run toward them with a loud roar.

label: 8과 38번
en: “Run, everybody! Run!” shouted Travis.

label: 8과 39번
en: Travis and the other travelers returned safely to the machine and found Eckels inside.

label: 8과 40번 ①
en: “You put all of us in danger,” said Travis to Eckels in an angry voice.

label: 8과 40번 ②
en: “You left the path.”

label: 8과 41번 ①
en: “I’m sorry, but I didn’t kill anything,” said Eckels.

label: 8과 41번 ②
en: “There’s only a little mud on my shoes.”

label: 8과 42번
en: Travis stared at Eckels for a long time without saying anything.

label: 8과 43번
en: “Let’s go home,” said Travis finally.

label: 8과 44번 ①
en: The machine stopped.

label: 8과 44번 ②
en: They all returned to the present safely.

label: 8과 45번
en: “Is everything okay here?” asked Travis.

label: 8과 46번
en: “Welcome home!” said Mr. Parker.

label: 8과 47번
en: Eckels looked around the room carefully.

label: 8과 48번
en: Everything looked the same, except the big sign on the wall.

label: 8과 49번 ①
en: The sign now said, “NAIM ANY YEER EN THE PAST. WEE TAEK YU THAIR.”

label: 8과 49번 ②
en: Eckels was confused.

label: 8과 50번 ①
en: Then, he saw the TV.

label: 8과 50번 ②
en: The new president was on the news, but it was not Mr. Keith.

label: 8과 51번 ①
en: “What’s going on?”

label: 8과 51번 ②
en: He got more confused.

label: 8과 52번
en: He sat down and looked closely at the mud on his shoes.

label: 8과 53번 ①
en: “No, it can’t be,” said Eckels.

label: 8과 53번 ②
en: “It’s all because of this little thing?”

label: 8과 53번 ③
en: He was shocked.

label: 8과 54번
en: In the mud on his right shoe, he found a small dead butterfly.
